interview_process.summary: The official hiring guide describes the following process. Confirm the exact loop for the role and level with the recruiter.

stages.name: Recruiter conversation
stages.signal: Discuss experience, goals, and the role over Zoom. Engineering candidates also receive technical questions.

stages.name: First interview
stages.signal: Meet a prospective leader or colleague. Engineers have a peer technical interview with a problem-solving challenge.

stages.name: Role-specific work assessment
stages.signal: The general process includes a take-home challenge; engineers are explicitly exempt and receive another opportunity to demonstrate their work, scoped by the recruiter.

stages.name: Final interview
stages.signal: The engineering guide describes a three-hour interview combining technical problem solving and experience questions. Other roles present challenge findings and discuss behavioral examples.

notes.label: Preparation context
notes.detail: Preparation inference from the product: collaborative editing, media handling, search, and reliable user-facing systems. Confirm the engineering assessment format with the recruiter.
